reason: No supplied measurement shows a repeatable gain; prior panel, padding, traversal, and K-loop variants were not promoted. I rank bounded prefetch first because it changes only the two K-loop blocks and preserves register use and traversal, though its benefit is unknown. The 64 KiB A-panel layout has a plausible reuse hypothesis but needs coordinated pointer and traversal changes. Address generation and the ZA mapping are narrower tests with uncertain benefit. The proposed two-K simplification conflicts with the supplied current one-step loop description and repeats territory tested by the unpromoted two-step variant, so it ranks last. The general-path transpose and tail proposals do not target the n=512 timed kernel.
